dishes.name: Har Gow
dishes.thoughts: Wrappers were thin and didn't tear. Best I've had this year.

dishes.name: Char Siu Bao
dishes.thoughts: A touch too sweet for me, but the table loved it.

dishes.name: Turnip Cake
dishes.thoughts: Crispy edges, soft center. Would come back for this alone.

notes: Busy Sunday crowd, cart service was fast. Solid choice for a group.

dishes.name: Rice Noodle Roll
dishes.thoughts: Sauce was a little thin, noodle texture was good though.

dishes.name: Egg Tart
dishes.thoughts: Flaky crust, still warm. No complaints.

notes: Unremarkable overall but the egg tart redeemed it. Service was slow.
